div.div: آسَالٌ a pl. having no sing.: (K:) mentioned by ISk as a word of which he had not heard any sing. (S.) You say, هُوَ عَلَى آسَالٍ مِنْ أَبِيهِ [in the CK, erroneously, اَسالٍ,] He is of a semblance and of characteristics and natural dispositions which are those of his father; (S, K;) like آسَانٍ. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
